summary: Visible change: until react-markdown has loaded, a message shows skeleton lines instead of its raw Markdown source; without react-markdown, plain text without Markdown syntax. The provider preloads it on mount; new preloadMarkdown() in glirastes/react.
howTo: Nothing to do. The placeholder is div[data-component="markdown"][data-state="loading"][aria-busy="true"] with span[data-element="markdown-placeholder-line"] per estimated line; color --cm-markdown-placeholder (default --cm-border), it pulses unless prefers-reduced-motion. When react-markdown cannot be loaded the text renders in div[data-component="markdown"][data-state="plain"]. Call preloadMarkdown() earlier (for example when the chat button renders) to load it before the provider mounts; it never rejects and does nothing on the server. Server-rendered chats render the placeholder and hydrate to Markdown. Tests that read the raw text of [data-component="markdown"] right after render, before the renderer loaded, wait for it (await preloadMarkdown() or waitFor). Apps with components.Markdown are unaffected and do not load react-markdown. To show mention chips in a chat restored with session.load or createLocalSessionStore before its next turn, set entityDeclarations; streamed declarations are not stored.
